epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Flow Core SYSTEM_STALLED occurrence rate from current to 0
requirements: R1: System must resume processing queued tasks when in SYSTEM_STALLED state, rather than remaining idle

slices.title: Patch Flow Core to recover from SYSTEM_STALLED state
slices.jtbd: When implementing recovery logic for this epic, I want to patch the Flow Core processor, so that the stalled pipeline resumes processing queued tasks
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given Flow Core is in SYSTEM_STALLED state with queued tasks,
When the system evaluates the state,
Then it must resume processing the queued tasks instead of remaining idle.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce queued task processing latency in stalled state from infinite to < 1s
